items: SpatialAudioComponent: Attaches a 3D spatial sound source to any [[Entity]]. Utilizes Web Audio's [[PannerNode]] to naturally pan and attenuate sound in 3D space based on the entity's position relative to the camera listener.

cells: Declared in this module; its precise contract appears below.

Attaches a 3D spatial sound source to any [[Entity]]. Utilizes Web Audio's [[PannerNode]] to naturally pan and attenuate sound in 3D space based on the entity's position relative to the camera listener.
